title: Against radiation-induced myelosuppression with Danggui Buxue Decoction: unraveling key pathways through network analysis and biological assays.
authors: Yu, Bin; Ren, Lin; Xu, Kexin; Xu, Hui; Lv, Guangyao; Sohail, Muhammad; Yang, Min
journal: Journal of the science of food and agriculture
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究当归补血汤抗辐射骨髓抑制，虽涉及DNA结合和分子对接，但核心是中药药理与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Radiotherapy often causes radiation-induced myelosuppression, adversely affecting patient health and treatment outcomes. Danggui Buxue Decoction (DBD), a traditional Chinese Medicine formula, has shown potential in alleviating X-ray-induced myelosuppression (X-IM) and promoting hematopoietic recovery, though its specific targets and mechanisms remain unclear. This study seeks to clarify DBD's targets and mechanisms in combating X-IM using bioinformatics and experimental methods. RESULTS: Network pharmacology was employed to identify 153 key targets of DBD for treating X-IM. Gene ontology enrichment analysis highlighted critical biological processes, cellular components, and molecular functions, including nucleus, cytoplasm, protein binding, and DNA binding. KEGG/DAVID analysis underscored the pivotal role of the phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B (PI3K/AKT) signaling pathway in DBD's protective effects against X-IM. Molecular docking validated the interaction of DBD's main components with core targets. The high-performance liquid chromatographic fingerprint analysis of DBD revealed distinct and reproducible peaks, indicating that its quality is controllable. Further content detection and component identification of calycosin and ferulic acid showed that the contents of key ingredients in DBD and their identities fully met the established requirements. Animal experiments demonstrated that DBD significantly accelerated the recovery of white blood cells, red blood cells, and platelets in X-IM-exposed mice, enhanced the secretion of hematopoietic factors like erythropoietin and granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor, and improved bone marrow cellularity and cell arrangement in the femurs of treated mice, as revealed by histopathological examination. Molecular analyses further confirmed that DBD significantly upregulated the mRNA expression of PI3K and AKT, consistent with the predictions from network pharmacology. The research employed a comprehensive strategy to explore the benefits and underlying mechanisms of DBD in addressing X-IM, ultimately laying a fresh groundwork for identifying and advancing natural therapeutic agents. abstract_zh: 背景：放射治疗常导致放射性骨髓抑制，对患者健康和治疗结果产生不利影响。当归补血汤（DBD）作为一种传统中药方剂，已显示出缓解X射线诱导的骨髓抑制（X-IM）和促进造血恢复的潜力，但其具体靶点和机制尚不明确。本研究旨在利用生物信息学和实验方法阐明DBD对抗X-IM的靶点和机制。结果：采用网络药理学方法鉴定出DBD治疗X-IM的153个关键靶点。基因本体富集分析突出了关键的生物过程、细胞组分和分子功能，包括细胞核、细胞质、蛋白质结合和DNA结合。KEGG/DAVID分析强调了磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶/蛋白激酶B（PI3K/AKT）信号通路在DBD对X-IM的保护作用中的关键角色。分子对接验证了DBD主要成分与核心靶点的相互作用。DBD的高效液相色谱指纹图谱分析显示出清晰且可重复的峰，表明其质量可控。对毛蕊异黄酮和阿魏酸的进一步含量检测和成分鉴定显示，DBD中关键成分的含量及其身份完全符合既定要求。动物实验表明，DBD显著加速了X-IM暴露小鼠中白细胞、红细胞和血小板的恢复，增强了促红细胞生成素和粒细胞-巨噬细胞集落刺激因子等造血因子的分泌，并通过组织病理学检查改善了处理小鼠股骨中的骨髓细胞性和细胞排列。分子分析进一步证实，DBD显著上调了PI3K和AKT的mRNA表达，这与网络药理的预测一致。本研究采用综合策略探讨了DBD应对X-IM的益处和潜在机制，最终为识别和推进天然治疗剂奠定了新的基础。(c) 2026 化学工业学会。
